items.title: As AI Grows More Complex, Model Builders Rely on NVIDIA
items.summary: Unveiling what it describes as the most capable model series yet for professional knowledge work, OpenAI launched GPT-5.2 in December. The model was trained and deployed on NVIDIA infrastructure, including NVIDIA Hopper and GB200 NVL72 systems. GPT-5.3 Codex — the first OpenAI agentic coding model to help build itself — was released in February and trained and served entirely on GB200 NVL72. GPT-5.2 achieves the top
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式发布GPT-5.2及GPT-5.3 Codex模型。GPT-5.2在GPQA-Diamond、AIME 2025及ARC-AGI-2等关键基准测试中表现卓越，代表了当前推理能力的最高水平。GPT-5.3 Codex作为首个具备自我构建能力的代理模型，在SWE-Bench Pro等测试中创下新高。该系列模型完全基于NVIDIA GB200 NVL72系统进行训练与部署，体现了算力规模与模型性能的深度绑定。

items.title: Advancing science and math with GPT-5.2
items.summary: GPT-5.2 is OpenAI’s strongest model yet for math and science, setting new state-of-the-art results on benchmarks like GPQA Diamond and FrontierMath. This post shows how those gains translate into real research progress, including solving an open theoretical problem and generating reliable mathematical proofs.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布GPT-5.2，该模型在GPQA Diamond和FrontierMath等高难度科学与数学基准测试中刷新了行业纪录。研究表明，这些性能提升已转化为实际科研价值，包括成功解决开放性理论问题并生成可靠的数学证明，标志着AI在科学发现领域迈出重要一步。

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.2
items.summary: GPT-5.2 is our most advanced frontier model for everyday professional work, with state-of-the-art reasoning, long-context understanding, coding, and vision. Use it in ChatGPT and the OpenAI API to power faster, more reliable agentic workflows.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI推出GPT-5.2，定位为面向专业工作的最先进前沿模型。该模型在推理、长上下文理解、编码及视觉能力方面均有显著提升，旨在通过API和ChatGPT平台支持更高效、更可靠的代理工作流，推动AI从对话工具向自动化执行代理的转变。

aiReview.reasonZh: GPT-5.2的发布重点强调了其在代理工作流中的应用能力，是模型演进的重要方向。

items.title: How Podium is arming 10,000+ SMBs with AI agents
items.summary: Discover how Podium used OpenAI’s GPT-5 to build “Jerry,” an AI teammate driving 300% growth and transforming how Main Street businesses serve customers.
items.summaryZh: Podium通过集成OpenAI的GPT-5模型，开发了名为“Jerry”的AI智能体，旨在为超过10,000家中小企业提供自动化服务。该智能体不仅充当了企业的虚拟员工，还通过深度交互优化了客户服务流程，成功驱动了相关业务300%的增长。这一案例展示了先进大模型在垂直行业中从实验走向规模化生产的潜力，为中小企业利用AI Agent实现数字化转型提供了可参考的范式。

items.title: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2
items.summary: GPT-5.2 is the latest model family in the GPT-5 series. The comprehensive safety mitigation approach for these models is largely the same as that described in the GPT-5 System Card and GPT-5.1 System Card. items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了GPT-5系列的新成员GPT-5.2，并同步更新了系统卡（System Card）。该模型在保持GPT-5系列架构的基础上，延续了既有的安全缓解措施。GPT-5.2的训练数据来源广泛，涵盖了公开互联网数据、第三方合作伙伴数据以及人类反馈数据。此次更新重点强调了模型在复杂环境下的安全合规性，体现了OpenAI在模型迭代过程中对安全性与数据治理的持续投入与透明化管理。

items.title: Ten years
items.summary: OpenAI reflects on ten years of progress, from early research breakthroughs to widely used AI systems that reshaped what’s possible. We share lessons from the past decade and why we remain optimistic about building AGI that benefits all of humanity.

items.title: The Walt Disney Company and OpenAI reach landmark agreement to bring beloved characters to Sora
items.summary: Disney and OpenAI have reached an agreement to bring more than 200 Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters to Sora for fan-inspired short videos. The agreement emphasizes responsible AI in entertainment and includes Disney’s company-wide use of ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API.
items.summaryZh: 迪士尼与OpenAI达成战略合作，将超过200个迪士尼、漫威、皮克斯及星球大战的经典角色引入Sora视频生成模型。该协议不仅支持粉丝创作短视频，还涵盖了迪士尼全公司范围内对ChatGPT Enterprise及OpenAI API的部署，旨在推动娱乐产业的AI化转型并强调负责任的AI使用标准。
